journey.text: Bainsla Music Private Limited founded in Rajasthan with a mission to promote Gurjar Rasiya and folk music.
Launched YouTube channel @bainslaofficial. Released 50+ songs. Crossed 10K subscribers and 1M+ views.
Grew to 256+ songs, 42+ artists. Started digital distribution to Spotify, JioSaavn, Gaana. DG Mawai tracks went viral.
50K+ subscribers, 12.8M+ views. Expanded services to website development, app development and digital marketing.

services.name: Music Distribution
services.description: Distribute your music across 150+ global platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, JioSaavn, Gaana, Wynk and more.
services.content:
Bainsla Music releases your music on 150+ global platforms — Spotify, Apple Music, JioSaavn, Gaana, Wynk, YouTube Music, Hungama and Amazon Music.

We handle the entire process: release planning, metadata, artwork, ISRC/UPC allocation, playlist pitching and royalty reporting — so the artist can focus only on the music.

With Content ID and copyright protection your catalogue stays monetised, and revenue is reported transparently.

services.name: Production House
services.description: Full-scale music video production with professional equipment, direction, editing and post-production services.
services.content:
Full-scale music video and audio production — from concept to final delivery.

Professional cameras, lighting, direction, choreography, location scouting, editing, colour grading and sound mixing, all with an in-house team.

We run a dedicated production unit in Rajasthan for Rasiya, folk, devotional and DJ tracks.

services.name: Artist Management
services.description: Complete artist management including bookings, brand deals, content strategy and career growth planning.
services.content:
Complete management for new and established artists — bookings, live shows, brand deals, content strategy and career planning.

We look after branding, social media growth, collaborations and the release calendar so growth stays consistent.

Our team coordinates contracts, payments and promotion end to end.

services.name: Website Development
services.description: Custom website design and development for artists, labels and music companies with admin panels and CMS.

services.name: Mobile App Development
services.description: Android and iOS app development for music streaming, artist management and fan engagement platforms.

services.name: Digital Marketing
services.description: Social media management, YouTube SEO, Instagram promotion and digital advertising for maximum reach.
